topic: The letter written by a teenager that accidentally started World War I
hook: A teenager's letter helped start World War One.
script: A teenager's letter helped start World War One. Gavrilo Princip was 19 when he assassinated Archduke Franz Ferdinand. His co-conspirators had already failed. He stopped for a sandwich. By chance, Ferdinand's car took a wrong turn. Princip was right there. Two shots. 20 million dead. History turned on a wrong turn and a sandwich. Follow for history moments that still feel unreal.
